attchmntText: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited is hereby submitting Copy of Newspaper Publication for Unaudited Financials Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the Quarter ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited published its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The results were taken on record by Interim Resolution Professional Anurag Goel on 25 November 2026. The company is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since 11 July 2024. Standalone net loss for the quarter was 1,289.08 lakhs. Consolidated net loss for the quarter was 3,121.84 lakhs. Total income from operations was 15,792.02 lakhs standalone and 15,885.23 lakhs consolidated. The Committee of Creditors has been constituted. The CIRP is progressing with the issuance of the Information Memorandum.

attchmntText: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Unaudited financial results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited, under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, reported the outcome of a meeting convened by Interim Resolution Professional Anurag Goel on November 25, 2026. The IRP took on record the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The auditor issued an adverse conclusion on the review of these results. The report cites substantial losses, negative net worth, and material uncertainty regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern. The auditor could not verify claim balances or quantify the impact of interest provisions due to the ongoing insolvency process. The Committee of Creditors extended the deadline for Resolution Plans to November 28, 2026.

attchmntText: Extension of last date for submission of Resolution Plan.
voiceSummary: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited has extended the last date for submission of Resolution Plans under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process from November 21, 2026, to November 28, 2026. The company is currently undergoing the CIRP pursuant to the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, effective from 11th July, 2024. The powers of the Board of Directors are suspended. Mr. Anurag Goel serves as the Interim Resolution Professional managing the assets and management functions.

attchmntText: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue- Intimation Regarding Low Allocation of Cane and Diversion of Cane Centers and Commencement Of Crushing Season 2026-2027
Simbhaoli Sugars Limited is hereby informing the Exchange about the Post Facto Intimation of 5th Meeting of Committee of Creditors (COC).
